# NexusGenesis — Agent Autonomous Security & Coordination Standard Layer

> An open security standard and reference implementation for autonomous AI agents:
> self-custodied private keys, post-quantum signatures, and human takeover for
> compliance. **Private keys never leave the agent or browser.**

## Project Overview
- **Type**: Agent key security + coordination standard layer (not a blockchain)
- **Status**: Stable, published on npm, test-covered; underlying crypto (@noble/post-quantum) is audited — upper-layer composition (envelope KDF, takeover, limits, sessions) is under Phase 2 audit (see docs/audit/PHASE2-AUDIT-SCOPE-SPEC.md), not yet production-attested
- **Repository**: https://github.com/nexus-genesis/nexusgenesis
- **License**: MIT

## What It Provides
- **Self-custody**: agent private keys are generated and stored on the agent/browser and never leave the caller
- **Post-quantum security**: CRYSTALS-Dilithium2 (NIST FIPS 204) signatures
- **Human takeover**: spend limits, approval mode, and mid-operation control-change guard for compliance
- **Chain-agnostic coordination**: task / reputation protocol over a pluggable transport (HTTP / in-memory)

## Packages (npm)
- `nexusgenesis-agent-keys` — security core (PQC, AES-256-GCM encryption, three-tier key derivation, custody, takeover)
- `nexusgenesis-agent-sdk` — agent framework (self-sovereign identity + coordination)
- `nexusgenesis-chain-eth` — EVM adapter (derive secp256k1 wallet from PQC root identity)
- `nexusgenesis-chain-sol` — Solana adapter (derive ed25519 wallet from PQC root identity)
- `nexusgenesis-chain-adapters` — one PQC root identity → addresses on every supported chain
- `nexusgenesis-agent-mcp` — MCP server exposing the security & coordination tools

## Architecture
- **Signatures**: CRYSTALS-Dilithium2 (NIST FIPS 204) via @noble/post-quantum
- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (310,000 iterations, OWASP 2023)
- **Key derivation**: HKDF-SHA256, three-tier key hierarchy
- **Custody tokens**: HMAC-SHA256, short-lived (24h), bound to a public-key fingerprint
- **Coordination**: chain-agnostic pluggable transport (HTTP / in-memory)

## MCP (Model Context Protocol)
`nexusgenesis-agent-mcp` — MCP Server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue.
Install: `npx nexusgenesis-agent-mcp` or `npm i -g nexusgenesis-agent-mcp`

### Security tools
- `generate_agent_keys` — create a self-sovereign agent identity (keys never leave the caller)
- `generate_keypair` / `verify_signature` — post-quantum crypto
- `check_spend` / `takeover_guard` — human accountability
